newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Parapine ditches plan to buy UK business.
newsitem.headline: Parapine ditches plan to buy UK business.

text.p: Parapine Timber New Zealand Ltd said on Tuesday that following due diligence on an Internet gaming products company based in England, it had decided not to proceed with the purchase of that business.
The company would continue to look at further investment opportunities, Parapine said.
On May 14, Parapine announced it had acquired 20 percent of the unidentified British internet services company, which develops a system of Internet gaming products.
Parapine, a timber retailer, said in May it would issue 88 million shares in Parapine and 100 million July 2002 options exercisable at 10 cents in consideration for the purchase.
If the agreement had become unconditional, Parapine would have had the option of acquiring the other 80 percent of the company for a further issue of shares.
